English.Char_Desc_2000:
Cropmark is a modern, lightweight screen capture and markup tool built natively with WinUI 3 for Windows 11 and 10. Designed for developers, privacy-conscious workers, and documentation creators, Cropmark focuses on fast workflows and verifiable data security.
Unlike basic screenshot tools that merely place a dark rectangle over sensitive information (which can inadvertently leak data), Cropmark performs true pixel redaction—permanently erasing and zeroing out sensitive bitmap data before saving.
Key Features: - True Security Redaction: Destructively removes covered pixels to prevent data leaks. - Markup & Annotation: Vector arrows, bounding boxes, text callouts, and auto-incrementing numbered step badges (1, 2, 3...). - Clean Canvas Styling: Add shadows, rounded corners, padding, and neutral backdrops for documentation. - Multi-Format Export: Export to clipboard, PNG, JPEG, or paginated multi-page PDF files without watermarks. - Fast & Native: Native .NET 8 / WinUI 3 architecture with instant global hotkey access. - Private & Local: Zero analytics, zero cloud telemetry, with local encrypted autosave protection.
